title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
DASVDD: Deep Autoencoding Support Vector
Data Descriptor for Anomaly Detection

extractions.description: This paper proposes a deep learning method for anomaly detection called DASVDD, which jointly learns the parameters of an autoencoder while minimizing the volume of an enclosing hypersphere on its latent representation. It introduces a novel anomaly score combining reconstruction error and distance from the hypersphere center.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on a novel method for anomaly detection, with potential applications across various fields. While anomaly detection can be useful in identifying issues related to sustainability, the paper itself does not focus on sustainable development themes.

Anomaly detection has been an active field of research in recent years due to its application
in a wide variety of domains, including fraud detection
[2], medical care [3], time-series anomaly detection [4], self-supervised
video surveillance [5], machine vision applications [6],
and industrial monitoring [7], [8].
